zero_relation.semantics: zero when exact bytes, grammar, length, and SHA-256 verify
zero when the filled literal record equals the validated boundary-value map
zero when all sixteen fixed-width initial state words equal the declared literal state
zero when UTF-8 canonical JSON plus one terminal line feed exactly encodes the record
zero when every certificate byte is assigned once to an ordered EMIT cell
zero when the derived Cell48 records serialize to the compilation-manifest .tmg hash

determinism.binary_format: TOMAGI ABI 1.0 little-endian header 128 + Cell48 records
determinism.canonical_json: UTF-8; sorted object keys; compact separators; no Unicode escaping
determinism.definition_schedule: strict unique (phase, ordinal), dependencies before dependents
